{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Group by species and calculate mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species', observed=True)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Mean flipper lengths by species:\n{mean_flipper_by_species}')
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species} ({highest_mean_value:.2f} mm)')}}
